# npc-actions

Make NPCs physically react to a conversation and follow spoken orders: TypeSafe's Jev returns a typed choice and a probability in about 0.1 s, per-action thresholds and a 60-second repeat cooldown pick an action (slap, punch, hug, kneel and beg, flee, flip off, square up, or nothing), orders at 0.6 or above override mood and have the LLM rewrite the line, and action names are mapped onto the game's animations with checks at load.
